values: Open Opportunities and use the header filters. Each role has a stable ID; multiple roles can belong to one project.
Change Application status instead of deleting or crossing out rows. Amber fields are yours: status, priority, submitted date, follow-up date and notes.
Submitted means your application was actually sent. Waitlisted, Callback and Booked track the outcome; do not infer success from silence.
Add a Follow-up on date for your own reminder. Submitted and waitlisted entries stop application-deadline reminders.
Save this same workbook after editing. Codex reads saved changes at the next review; this is not an instant shared live session.
Keep the file path unchanged. If you move or rename it, tell Codex the new path. Close Excel before a scheduled refresh to avoid a file lock.
5pm and 9pm Vancouver reviews should read this file first, preserve your edits, add new records, and remind only on relevant unfinished actions.
Focus is new and upcoming opportunities from Facebook and Backstage. Past deadlines are retained on Past; no exhaustive historical search.
Dates are Vancouver-local unless a listing says otherwise. Blank deadline/rate means unknown, never zero or automatically open.
Before Dec 1? checks shoot dates only. Ongoing jobs, unknown dates and post-trip productions need your availability confirmation.
No messages or applications are sent by updating this workbook. You submit applications; Codex researches and maintains the tracker.
